recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create `Prism Drop Matrix`, a mobile-first portrait Tetris falling-block puzzle. Use a 10x20 grid, seven tetrominoes, gravity, keyboard and touch controls, wall-kick rotation attempts, hard drop, soft drop, lock/merge behavior, full-row clearing, score/line/level progression, escalating fall speed, next-piece preview, ghost landing silhouette, and top overflow game-over. Present it as a neon prism optimization chamber with luminous beveled blocks, a visible danger line, compact thumb controls, readable HUD, and procedural animated background. Keep mechanics classic and clear; transform presentation through sci-fi geometric rhythm and mobile-safe visual hierarchy.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Current Game Truth
- genre: single-screen canvas puzzle preserved as `index_old.html`; original runtime was a rotate-to-connect grid/pipe puzzle, not a falling-block game.
- objective: old surface asked the player to rotate cells until all tiles were powered; new canonical prompt target is a Tetris-style falling-block matrix.
- input model: old surface used pointer taps on canvas plus a restart CTA; rebuilt surface uses keyboard, touch gestures, and thumb buttons for left/right/rotate/soft drop/hard drop.
- core loop: spawn tetromino, move/rotate while gravity drops, lock into 10x20 board, clear full rows, score, escalate speed, repeat.
- fail/friction state: pieces reaching the hidden top/danger line trigger matrix overflow/game over with restart.

## Protected Mechanics
- Falling-block truth: seven tetromino families, grid collision, wall kick attempts, gravity, lock/merge, full-row removal, score/line/level progression, escalating fall interval, restart.
- Mobile actionability: visible portrait board, reachable controls, tap/drag gestures, non-blocking overlay CTA.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, prism block rendering, neon matrix background, danger-line copy, audio feedback, fonts, score labels, overlay language, and procedural cell styling are safe to transform without changing falling-block semantics.

preserve_transform: transform UI and world into Prism Drop Matrix
